notes.title: Update – August ２, 2025
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where setting two 効 Mudra incorrectly reduced the card cost by 2.

notes.title: Update – July 26, 2025
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where card information was displayed multiple times when two 組 mudra were set on the same card.

notes.title: Update – July 15, 2025
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where card effects were not being displayed correctly in the deck or other views.

 UI Improvements
Adjusted the position of mudra description windows to prevent them from appearing off-screen in certain cases.

notes.title: Update – July 10, 2025
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where cards obtained via the Lucky Stick effect could come with mudra. Now they are obtained without sigils as intended.

Balance Adjustments
The number of times 発 Mudra can activate has been limited to a maximum of 10.

notes.title: Update – July 3, 2025
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where the description for Upgrade Parts was not being displayed.
Fixed a bug where some relic effects were not resetting properly after combat.
Fixed an issue where Rush was performing one fewer attack than intended.

notes.title: Update – July 1, 2025
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where the game would freeze after selecting "Continue" following a save made after a boss fight.
Fixed a freeze that occurred when entering the shop after continuing a game.
Fixed incorrect unlock conditions for the Rapid and Sniper achievements.

notes.title: Update – June 29, 2025
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
Fixed a freeze that occurred when using a draw card with a sigil while holding the Patchwork Sword.
Fixed a bug where cards with Expend would not remain in the hand after triggering Finishing Blow.
Fixed an issue where Dash was not activating correctly at 前Mudra Lv3.
Fixed an issue where cards activated by 発Mudra were still consuming mana.

notes.title: Update – June 28, 2025
notes.notes: [p]Bug Fixes[/p][p]・Fixed an issue where progress was not being saved correctly on the result screen.[/p][p]Visual Updates[/p][p]・Updated the visual for tiles that trigger special actions.[/p]
